models.name: SiteProfile

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Matches the input site id

fields.name: name
fields.description: Site name

fields.name: country
fields.description: Likely country or territory

fields.name: region
fields.description: Region or province

fields.name: nearest_settlement
fields.description: Nearest city or settlement

fields.name: climate_zone
fields.description: Climate classification (e.g. subarctic, polar, temperate)

fields.name: is_cold_location
fields.description: True if routinely below freezing for much of the year

fields.name: facility_type_guess
fields.description: Best guess: research lab, military, industrial, logistics, etc.

fields.name: is_likely_research_lab
fields.description: True if the site plausibly hosts scientific research

fields.name: is_russian_or_post_soviet
fields.description: True if in Russia or a former Soviet state

fields.name: profile_summary
fields.description: Two-sentence analyst profile of the location

fields.description: High-level findings across all sites

fields.name: similarity_clusters
fields.description: Named clusters with member site ids and shared traits

fields.name: russian_site_ids
fields.description: Sites flagged as Russian or post-Soviet

fields.name: research_lab_site_ids

fields.name: cold_location_site_ids

modules.label: GPS Site Catalog
modules.inputDescription: JSON catalog of GPS sites with coordinates, names, and facility notes
modules.note: JSON catalog of GPS sites with coordinates, names, and facility notes

modules.label: Parse GPS Sites
modules.note: JSON catalog → list[GPSLocation]. No LLM cost.
modules.inputDescription: GPS site catalog Document from the upload step, ready to parse into site locations

modules.label: Profile Each Location
modules.note: list[GPSLocation] → list[SiteProfile]. One structured LLM call per site.
modules.inputDescription: List of GPSLocation objects — site id, coordinates, name, and notes
modules.prompt: Profile this GPS site from its coordinates and notes. Infer country, region, nearest settlement, and climate zone from latitude/longitude. Set is_cold_location true for polar, subarctic, or routinely sub-zero climates. Guess facility_type_guess from the name and notes (research lab, military, industrial, logistics, etc.). Set is_likely_research_lab and is_russian_or_post_soviet from geography and context. Keep the same site_id and name as the input. Write a concise two-sentence profile_summary.

modules.label: Bundle Profiles
modules.note: list[SiteProfile] → ProfileCollection for the cross-site similarity step.
modules.inputDescription: List of SiteProfile objects — inferred geography and facility traits per GPS site

modules.label: Evaluate Similarities
modules.note: ProfileCollection → SimilarityReport (single object, not a list).
modules.inputDescription: ProfileCollection with profiles_json — all site profiles serialized for cross-site analysis
modules.prompt: Analyze all site profiles in profiles_json. Group sites into similarity_clusters — each entry should name the cluster, list member site_ids, and explain shared traits (e.g. Russian Arctic installations, polar research hubs, high-security western labs). Populate russian_site_ids, research_lab_site_ids, and cold_location_site_ids from the profiles. List notable_pairs of the most similar sites with a one-line rationale each. Write an executive_summary of the overall pattern. Return one SimilarityReport object, not an array.

modules.label: Similarity Analysis Output
modules.inputDescription: Single SimilarityReport object — clusters, notable pairs, and executive summary
